slug: 2026-02-04 Sudatel-Djibouti Telecom-Ethio telecom launch Horizon Fiber cross-border initiative (SUNA)

facts.fact: SUNA reports Sudatel signed a strategic agreement on 4 February 2026 with Djibouti Telecom and Ethio telecom to launch Horizon Fiber, a terrestrial fibre corridor from Djibouti's cable stations through Ethiopia to Sudan.
